title: Longest Subsequence With Limited Sum
summary: Given an integer array nums and an integer array queries, return an array answer where each element is the maximum size of a subsequence from nums whose sum is less than or equal to the corresponding query.
statement: Given an integer array nums and an integer array queries, return an array answer where each element is the maximum size of a subsequence from nums whose sum is less than or equal to the corresponding query. A subsequence is derived by removing elements from the original array while maintaining the order of the remaining elements.
constraints: For each query, choose any subsequence whose sum is at most that query.
Return the maximum possible subsequence length for every query in original query order.
hints: To maximize count under a sum limit, choose the smallest values first.
Sort nums and build cumulative prefix sums.
For each query, binary-search the number of prefix sums no greater than it.
Any same-length selection costs at least the sorted prefix of that length, so the largest affordable prefix length is optimal.
editorial: Any same-length selection costs at least the sorted prefix of that length, so the largest affordable prefix length is optimal.

tests.explanation: Sorted prefix sums are one, three, seven, and twelve, giving lengths two, three, and four.
Even the smallest value exceeds one, so the answer is zero.
